Privacy & Savegame

Special features of "SQL Moon" (runs in your browser)

SQL runs locally: Your queries are executed exclusively in your browser (AlaSQL, JavaScript). The game's database is a practice database held in memory. Your input is not sent to a server.

What is stored? Your progress (the number of the last task you reached) is saved in your browser's local storage (localStorage) so you can continue later. Nothing is stored on the server. You can remove the entry at any time with "Restart" or by clearing the site data in your browser.
